exact_statement: For any exclusive finite physical controller selecting mutually independent disjoint Boolean cores u_j (or constant signs), let q_j be selector probabilities and let I_data,I_ctrl be the root influences of data and control coordinates. At an actual data query of core j set m=Eu_j,beta=hat u_j(i),v=1-m^2,t=beta^2,a=hat W+m hat C_j and M(s)=sum_T Phi(a_T^2,s hat C_j(T)^2), Phi(A,B)=A log2(1/A)+B log2(1/B)-(A+B)log2(1/(A+B)). With cap=min(M(v),t M(v)/v+q_j t log2(v/t)) and zero cap at t=0 or v=0, every finite adaptive interleaved data-only prefix satisfies sum w cap<=[(1+2/e)/ln2]Pi_I,data+sum_j q_j log2(1/q_j)V_drop,j<=[(1+2/e)/ln2]I_data+2I_ctrl. The exact projected-sector concavity gap J obeys 0<=J<=2q_j t/ln2, hence sum w(cap+J)<=[(3+2/e)/ln2]I_data+2I_ctrl<=[(3+2/e)/ln2]I(F). Actual inner signed entropy and terminal entropy are not paid by this statement.

On every finite adaptive interleaved data-only prefix, H(F)=E H(F_leaf)+sum_j q_j[E_ne(u_j)-E E_ne(u_j,leaf)]-sum_nodes w q_j phi(beta_node^2)+sum_nodes w(M_node+J_node). At each projected empty-core sector, M0=1-q_j(1-m^2)+q_j beta^2, M_plus/minus=M0+/-2q_j m beta and rho_plus/minus=M_plus/minus/(2M0), and J=M0 JS_rho(P_plus,P_minus)+M0[1-h2(rho_plus)], with zero-mass endpoints by continuity. The rho weights are spectral sector weights; physical query outcomes remain fair. For same-orientation priority with one private bit per event and both cores (1,1,1,-1), the data-first constant-core terminal entropy is 11/8-(9/32)log2(3)>3/4, the control-first terminal entropy. Thus the two stopping-frontier reserves cannot be interchanged.
